verdict.rationale: Jan is itself an AI assistant app, and its docs say you can give it a task to work on autonomously across files, commands and web research. It supports custom assistants with personas that can be assigned per project, MCP integration for agentic tool use with inline per-call approval, and browser automation via Jan Browser MCP. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that autonomous delegation works reliably, and in-depth docs on the autonomous task loop beyond headline marketing statements.
